newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Hail damage in Montana.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Hail damage in Montana.

text.p: Moderate hail damage was reported in Montana on Tuesday as farmers scouted their fields following a heavy storm late Sunday, several cash grain dealers said.

"We got a big gusher on Sunday with lots of hail about 25 miles south of Billings," a south-central Montana dealer said. "We probably lost a couple of thousand acres. One guy lost 500 acres of wheat. It was just flattened."
The rains subsided on Monday and skies were clear on Tuesday, allowing some farmers to begin harvesting hard red winter wheat, a northeast Montana dealer said.
"They're just starting to do some cutting," he said. Spring wheat harvest was expected to begin in two to four weeks, he added.
Bids for dark northern spring wheat were mostly higher, in line with gains in MGE futures. One dealer, however, said basis levels dropped as movement picked up slightly.
"We dropped our basis back quite a bit this afternoon. We've bought some wheat and people are pretty well covered.
